name: deployment-docker
title: Docker: a container, restarted by Docker; self-improvement's deployer beside it
description: Runs a pikit project in Docker on a server: the image (with git), the container, the process entrypoint, its logs, the commands `pikit up | down | restart | logs | status` delegate to, and self-improvement's deployer, a second service started by the same `pikit up`, which merges, checks and deploys what an operator approves and rolls back when unhealthy.
